# Licensing & Compliance Checklist: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 Licensing

**Purpose**: Check how well the licensing requirements are written: the project license text and
notice, the commercial-licensing terms, and the third-party license information that ships inside
the distributed packages.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/distribution-layout.md](../contracts/distribution-layout.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the authoritative source of the license text (publisher, version, exact file) specified in the requirements rather than only in the research notes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the exact Required Notice wording specified? Is its position relative to the license text (before or after) fixed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is every distribution channel that must carry the Required Notice listed explicitly: repository, packaged artifact, deployed build metadata and container image? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK004 - Do the requirements define what "bundled third-party library" covers? For example, does it include components of the container base image (JRE, OS packages), or only libraries inside the packaged artifact? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the required fields of the third-party listing defined (name, version, license, plus a source or URL)? Is it stated which fields are mandatory? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is it specified which kinds of clarification must be recorded? For example: the license elected from several options, a license asserted where metadata is missing, and source-availability statements for licenses that require them. [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for passing on the NOTICE content of bundled libraries, including the case where several libraries ship NOTICE files that would collide? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 - Does the spec require the README summary to state that the license file prevails over the summary (that the summary is non-binding)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are requirements defined for the other places that describe the project, such as the `docs/` and `wiki/` pages and the API description's license field? Is it stated explicitly whether they are in scope? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 - Does the contribution guidance requirement say how a contributor shows agreement (a statement in the PR, sign-off, a CLA), or is reading the guidance considered sufficient? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 - Is "complete, unaltered text" made objectively checkable, for example with a pinned version or a checksum? Is it defined which whitespace or line-wrapping differences are tolerated, if any? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases "Text drift"]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the plain-language summary of "permitted noncommercial use" required to match the categories the license itself names (personal uses, noncommercial organisations)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "commercial use requires a separate license" phrased so that internal use at a for-profit company is clearly covered, consistent with the license's own definitions? [Clarity, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is it clear whether FR-015 means "add a clarification entry **or** let the build fail", or that the build fails until a clarification exists? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "a predictable location" for the license file inside the container image replaced by a concrete, documented path in the spec or its contract? [Clarity, Spec §US3 Scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "near the top" of the README quantified, for example within the first screen or directly under the title? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the meaning of "standard image license metadata field" pinned to a named field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK018 - Is the copyright holder's identity (name, URL, email) consistent across the Required Notice, the README contact, the build metadata, the image metadata and the contribution guidance? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK019 - Do the User Story 1 acceptance scenario 3, FR-003 and SC-001 now agree on what the hosting platform shows, after the "Other" classification finding? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §FR-003, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the edge-case statement that the change "does not rewrite previously published artifacts" consistent with the changelog wording required by FR-010? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the assumption that the release is a MINOR bump consistent with the constitution's versioning rules and with the plan's stated release version? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Notes]
- [ ] CHK022 - Do FR-006 (the README points to the in-package notices) and the assumption that no notices file is committed to the repository agree on where a repository reader finds third-party license information? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK023 - Can SC-003 ("under 1 minute" to understand the terms) be measured objectively? Is the method or test reader defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is SC-006 ("100% of bundled libraries listed, zero extras") measurable against a defined reference set of "bundled libraries"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK025 - Does every functional requirement FR-001 to FR-015 trace to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is SC-005 ("zero functional diff") bounded to observable service behaviour, with expected non-functional differences such as image size listed? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §Assumptions]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for the recurring scenario of updating the copyright year span (when, by whom, and whether an update blocks a release)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "Copyright years"]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for a dependency upgrade that changes a library's license (for example from permissive to copyleft or non-redistributable)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is there a requirement to assess whether every bundled third-party license is compatible with redistribution under the project's terms? For example, copyleft obligations such as source availability for MPL, EPL and LGPL components. [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for third-party code embedded inside another library (nested or shaded dependencies) so that it isn't missed? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the treatment of test-only and build-only tools stated as a requirement rather than only an assumption? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are requirements defined for the case where a published artifact is found to be missing the license or notices after release (for example re-publish or a corrective release)? [Recovery, Gap]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Risks

- [ ] CHK033 - Is the assumption that there is a single copyright holder recorded with how it was established? Is there a requirement to re-check it before release? [Assumption, Spec §Context, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is publishing a personal contact email in the README, the package metadata and the image metadata recorded as a deliberate, accepted decision? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the dependency on the hosting platform's license detection documented as an external constraint, with its limitation (PolyForm is classed as "Other")? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK036 - Does the spec state that no additional terms or exceptions are added to the license, and that the license is not legal advice or reviewed by counsel? Does the spec say whether a legal review is required before release? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Several items (CHK001, CHK014, CHK015, CHK017, CHK029) are already answered in `research.md` or `contracts/distribution-layout.md`. Each one passes only if that answer is promoted into, or explicitly referenced by, the spec.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
